about_the_game:
Bounce to the Beat, Fart to Fight!

Jump into a wild musical adventure where you control an adorably round dragon with a rather explosive personality! This is a crazy mix of rhythm-action, roguelite, and bullet hell, all in a wild 3D platforming world. Timing is everything – hit the beat to survive and blast your way through!

🎵 RHYTHM-BASED COMBAT

Unleash your power on the perfect beat! Your little dragon's powerful... err... "special attacks" only hit hard when you sync up with the pumping soundtrack. Master the rhythm to dominate waves of enemies.

🌈 INFINITE ADVENTURE

No two runs are ever the same! Explore an endless, procedurally generated dungeon that keeps changing. New sections bring new challenges and enemies. How far can you push into this rhythmic chaos?

🗺️ UNFOLD THE MAP

Your run expands with every enemy you defeat! Collect energy drops to activate new platform sections and unlock more of the sprawling musical dungeon. Push your limits, explore further, and see how long you can survive as the map unfolds around you.

🐲 MEET YOUR HERO

Take control of the most unconventional dragon ever – a bouncy, spherical little guy whose unique "talent" turns out to be his ultimate weapon. Who knew being gassy could be so powerful?

🎮 EASY TO LEARN, CHALLENGING TO MASTER

Simple, intuitive controls get you bouncing and blasting fast. But deep mechanics and increasing challenges mean you'll need skill and practice to survive the endless run. Perfect for quick blasts or long sessions!

Dodge, bounce, collect energy, and blast through this energetic musical adventure where rhythm meets roguelite in the most unexpected way. Can you help our round friend become the master of the musical madness?

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Graphics 4000, 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A rhythmic roguelite starring a cute dragon who fights with musical farts! Time your attacks to the beat, defeat enemies for energy coins, and trigger new platforms before the old ones crumble in this fast-paced 3D adventure where standing still means certain doom.
